subject: viper_nose_dive
description_zh: 冥界亚龙冲向地面，释放幽冥剧毒并且%corrosive_radius%范围内所有敌人均被溅上持续%effect_duration%秒的腐蚀皮肤酸液。
description_en: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a %corrosive_radius% AoE for %effect_duration% seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.

subject: viper_predator
description_zh: 冥界亚龙的攻击会根据目标英雄缺失的生命百分比额外造成一次物理伤害。
description_en: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.

subject: viper_viper_strike
description_zh: 蝮蛇降低敌方目标单位的移动和攻击速度，同时破坏其被动技能并造成持续毒素伤害。移动和攻击速度会在毒素的持续时间内逐渐恢复。
description_en: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.

subject: luna_lucent_beam
description_zh: 召唤一道月能的光束打击敌人，造成伤害并短暂眩晕目标。
description_en: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.

subject: luna_lunar_orbit
description_zh: 产生%rotating_glaives%个月刃在露娜身旁%rotating_glaives_movement_radius%范围内旋转。任何碰到月刃的敌方单位都会受到露娜攻击伤害的一定百分比。
description_en: Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.

shard.zh: 提升伤害降低效果。开启时，露娜获得%bonus_movement_speed%%%移动速度加成。
shard.en: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed.

subject: luna_moon_glaive
description_zh: 强化露娜的月刃，使攻击可以在敌方单位之间弹跳。每次弹跳造成的伤害都会减少。
description_en: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
notes_zh: 月刃不会触发致命一击以外的任何攻击特效。

subject: luna_lunar_blessing
description_zh: 提升露娜和附近%radius%范围内友方英雄的攻击力，露娜获得双倍的攻击力加成。夜晚期间月之祝福为全地图生效，并且露娜受到福佑后夜间视野提升。
description_en: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within %radius% range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.

subject: luna_eclipse
description_zh: 召唤一次月蚀，以她当前技能等级的月光随机打击附近敌人。月光只有伤害效果，不会造成眩晕，而且单一目标只能受到有限次数的打击。月蚀会暂时将白天变为黑夜。
description_en: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
notes_zh: 如果露娜没有升级月光，月蚀将无法造成伤害，但是变为黑夜效果有效。
露娜阵亡后月光马上中止。
每道月光之间都有%beam_interval%秒的间隔。神杖升级后间隔为%beam_interval_scepter%秒。

scepter.zh: 露娜可以对友方单位或自身施放月蚀，使月蚀的效果跟随目标，或者对一片区域施放。增加月光数量，减少月蚀持续时间，并且移除单体打击次数上限，月光的产生间隔缩短一半。
scepter.en: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.

subject: dragon_knight_breathe_fire
description_zh: 向龙骑士的前方喷射出一团火焰，烧灼碰到的敌人，并使其攻击力降低。
description_en: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

subject: dragon_knight_dragon_tail
description_zh: 龙骑士用盾对身边的一个敌方单位进行打击，对它和它身边的目标造成眩晕和伤害。
description_en: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.

subject: dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath
description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的技能和物品，使其拥有作用范围加成，并且攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害。
description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

subject: dragon_knight_fireball
description_zh: 点燃一片区域，对其中的敌人持续造成伤害，伤害效果还会粘滞。近战形态下施放距离较近。
description_en: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

subject: dragon_knight_dragon_blood
description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的生命恢复和护甲。在古龙形态下生命恢复和护甲均提升%regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%%。
description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.  Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.

subject: dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form
description_zh: 龙骑士化身为古龙，提升了技能的施法距离，获得移动速度加成，和拥有各种特性的远程攻击。古龙每级都会进化。加成效果会累加。1级碧龙：攻击获得持续的腐蚀伤害，也能作用于建筑。2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。3级苍龙：攻击获得无视减益免疫的移动速度和攻击速度降低效果。
description_en: Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties.  The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.

scepter.zh: 使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。
scepter.en: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

subject: dazzle_poison_touch
description_zh: 施放一股锥形的毒素，可以打击多个敌方单位。造成持续伤害和减速。每当目标受到戴泽的攻击，负面效果的持续时间都会刷新，减速效果也会提升。
description_en: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
notes_zh: 伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。

subject: dazzle_shallow_grave
description_zh: 友军身受薄葬的福佑，在其保护下不论受到多大的伤害都不会阵亡。对该友军的治疗效果在持续时间内也会根据其生命值得到增强。
description_en: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
notes_zh: 在薄葬作用下生命值至少为1点，但是斧王的淘汰之刃还是可以斩杀目标英雄。

subject: dazzle_shadow_wave
description_zh: 放出一道能量弧，可以瞬间跳跃至目标附近的队友，治疗的同时还将对附近的敌方单位造成伤害。施放暗影波时戴泽必定会享受到治疗效果。
description_en: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
notes_zh: 如果敌军附近有多个我方单位，那么他将受到多重暗影波的伤害。

scepter.zh: 暗影波现在也可对敌人施放，在友军和敌人之间都可以弹跳。弹跳至敌人时，他们会受到伤害，并且治疗附近友军，数值为%scepter_heal_pct%%%平常治疗和伤害量。戴泽还会对暗影波弹跳到的每个敌人发动一次攻击。
scepter.en: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

subject: dazzle_innate_weave
description_zh: 戴泽的技能会对范围内友军和敌人同时施加编织，提升友军的护甲并减少敌人的护甲。本效果可以多次叠加。
description_en: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.

shard.zh: 对友军施加编织时，每层编织效果治疗%ally_heal%点。
shard.en: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.

subject: dazzle_nothl_projection
description_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。在灵魂形态下，戴泽的基础技能都已强化：剧毒之触带有妖术效果；薄葬结束时会治疗；暗影波的冷却时间变短。效果可以提前结束，效果结束时戴泽的灵魂会返回身体。
description_en: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
notes_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体超过%leash_start%距离后会被拉向身体。戴泽的灵魂移动得越远，拉力就越大。
戴泽的灵魂不能攻击建筑。

subject: rattletrap_battery_assault
description_zh: 向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂眩晕。
description_en: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
notes_zh: 发条技师被控制后仍然有效。

subject: rattletrap_power_cogs
description_zh: 在发条技师周围形成一圈通电的齿轮，困住附近的单位。在外侧的敌人碰到齿轮会被电流震退，损失一定的生命和魔法。并且%mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%%损失魔法也会加入到伤害。一个齿轮发动过一次震击后就会报废。敌人攻击齿轮数次后可将其摧毁，而发条技师需要攻击一次会将齿轮推出%projectile_distance%距离。发条技师可以自由穿行齿轮，穿行时会使齿轮失效。
description_en: Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned. Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
notes_zh: 齿轮可以震退隐身单位。

subject: rattletrap_rocket_flare
description_zh: 向全地图范围内的指定区域发射照明弹。击中时对区域内敌人造成伤害和短暂减速。照明火箭提供%duration%秒击中区域的视野。
description_en: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for %duration% seconds.

subject: rattletrap_overclocking
description_zh: 使发条技师的所有技能变得强力：弹幕冲击：作用范围提升，并且可以作用于范围内所有敌人。能量齿轮：成型范围提升，并且发条技师靠近能量齿轮时护甲提升。照明火箭：伤害、视野和减速时间提升，并且发射时向目标两侧各额外发射一枚。发射钩爪：眩晕范围和时间均有提升。喷气背包：移动得更快。持续时间结束后发条技师的移动和攻击速度降到最低。
description_en: Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.Jetpack: Moves faster.Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

subject: rattletrap_jetpack
description_zh: 发条技师开动喷气背包，获得飞行移动状态，飞行视野和移动速度加成。发条技师的转身速率大幅降低，并且无法攻击。在加成状态的持续时间内可以开启和关闭喷气背包。
description_en: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

subject: rattletrap_hookshot
description_zh: 向目标位置高速射出钩爪，如果命中一个单位，发条技师会将自己牵引到目标身边，对目标附近%stun_radius%范围内所有敌人造成眩晕和伤害。对牵引时冲撞到的单位也造成伤害和眩晕。
description_en: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a %stun_radius% radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
notes_zh: 发射钩爪可以抓住友方单位并将发条技师牵引过去，但是不会造成伤害和眩晕。
